items.titleEn: OpenAI Accelerates Device Plan With AI Camera Tech Acquisition
items.summaryEn: OpenAI has acquired Glass Imaging , a startup founded by former Apple employees that is developing artificial intelligence-enhanced cameras for smartphones, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday (Sept. 14), citing unnamed sources. Δ document.getElementById( "ak_js_1" ).setAttribute( "value", ( new Date() ).getTime() ); Glass Imaging is working on AI technology that enables smartphone cameras to produce image quality similar to that of DLSR cameras, according to the report.
